title: Double Drip Watermelon 100ml Shortfill
description: Double Drip’s Watermelon captures summer in a bottle with a cool, sweet and refreshing vape tailormade for hot, sunny, carefree days. Soak your senses in the succulent flavour of fresh, juicy Watermelon – light yet satisfyingly sweet and full-flavoured, this ludicrously refreshing e-liquid experience delivers a heady explosion of uplifting Watermelon flavour that’ll soak your senses in sunshine with every giddy vape you take, while bringing a little icy cool with a subtle dash of icy menthol. Why not twist your melon, man, with Double Drip’s Watermelon e-liquid today! Long-lasting 100ml shortfill bottles from Double Drip offer the ideal way to personalize your favourite e-liquid flavours by adding nicotine to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots , giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Alternatively, leave out the nicotine entirely and simply enjoy the pure, delicious flavour and rich, billowing sub-ohm clouds. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as more economical and convenient alternative to smaller bottles of high-vg e-liquid. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils , ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production from your device. Discover the ultimate vaping experience with Double Drip E-Liquid, a hugely popular and influential vape juice brand proudly made in the UK. With a wide range of e-liquid formulations to suit all e-cigarette setups, Double Drip has an e-juice for every preference. Whether you prefer sub-ohm (high-VG) e-liquid , 50/50 e-liquid , Nicotine Salts , or long-lasting shortfills, Double Drip has you covered. Please note: This shortfill contains a high concentrate of flavour when compared to 50ml Double Drip shortfills
